components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The only primary CTA — white pill on canvas.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #FFFFFF; color: #0E0E10; padding: 10px 15px; border-radius: 100px; border: none; font: 500 14px/1 'Inter Variable'; letter-spacing: -0.14px; transition: transform 120ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.88); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #1A1A1D; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 10px 15px; border-radius: 100px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); font: 500 14px/1 'Inter Variable'; letter-spacing: -0.14px; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #242428; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form fields — surface-1 fill, hairline border, blue focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #1A1A1D; color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; font: 400 15px/1.3 'Inter Variable'; letter-spacing: -0.15px; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #999999; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,153,255,0.15); border-color: transparent; }

components.name: Spotlight Card
components.description: The single gradient atmosphere card — the drive empty state.
components.html:
This folder is empty

Drag and drop files here, or use the buttons above.
components.css: .ds-spotlight { background: linear-gradient(140deg, #5B21B6 0%, #7C3AED 48%, #A78BFA 100%); border-radius: 30px; padding: 40px; text-align: center; max-width: 560px; margin: 0 auto; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-spotlight h2 { font: 500 32px/1.13 'Mona Sans Variable'; letter-spacing: -1.0px; color: #FFFFFF; margin: 15px 0 5px; } .ds-spotlight p { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); font: 400 13px/1.2 'Inter Variable'; } .ds-spotlight button { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35); border-radius: 100px; padding: 10px 15px; font: 500 14px/1 'Inter Variable'; } .ds-spotlight button:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.22); }

components.name: Entry Table Row
components.description: Canvas row, surface-1 hover, surface-2 selected; hover reveals circular action icons.
components.css: .ds-row { cursor: pointer; } .ds-row td { padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: #FFFFFF; font: 400 15px/1.3 'Inter Variable'; letter-spacing: -0.15px; } .ds-row:hover { background: #1A1A1D; } .ds-row.selected { background: #242428; }

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Surface-2 modal with light-edge-strong elevation, 20px radius.
components.html:
New folder

Folders can contain files and other folders.
components.css: .ds-dialog { background: #242428; border-radius: 20px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.12), 0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-dialog h3 { font: 700 22px/1.2 'Inter Variable'; letter-spacing: -0.8px; margin: 0 0 16px; }

narrative.overview: Wyvern Drive wears the Framer dark-canvas marketing world the way Framer wears it: a near-black canvas with a faint warmth, oversized white display type with hard negative tracking, and one chromatic accent (blue) that is a signal, never a fill. The app is a poster at the edges (login, share links) and a quiet instrument in the middle (the drive itself): scanability, density, and the familiar cloud-drive idioms outrank expression once the user is inside. Hierarchy is carried by surface lift — canvas to surface-1 to surface-2 — never by color ramps or opacity tricks on white type. The text scale is binary: ink or ink-muted. The only chromatic depth in the whole system is the scarce gradient spotlight card (the drive's empty state).
keyCharacteristics: Near-black canvas everywhere; no light mode
Massive negative letter-spacing on display sizes (Mona Sans 500)
White pill is the only primary CTA
One gradient spotlight card — the drive empty state
Inter Variable body with OpenType variants cv01/cv05/cv09/cv11/ss03/ss07/dlig
Cloud-drive side rail; monochrome file-type glyphs
Light-edge elevation: white top edge over a deep drop shadow

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Accent blue is reserved for links, focus, and selection. If you reach for a second blue — or a blue button fill — the brand is drifting.

rules.name: The Binary Ink Rule
rules.body: Secondary type is ink-muted (#999999) or it is ink. No mid-tone grays, no opacity gradients on white type.

rules.name: The Lift Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy on dark is marked by surface lift (canvas to surface-1 to surface-2), never by color or brightness of type.

rules.name: The Tracking Rule
rules.body: Letter-spacing scales with size, hard: display pulls ~5% negative, body sticks to ~1%. Reduce size before reducing the percentage.

rules.name: The Variant Rule
rules.body: The Inter OpenType variants (cv01 cv05 cv09 cv11 ss03 ss07 dlig) are the body voice. Switching them off visibly changes the brand.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat until they float (hover, selection, dialog). Shadows mark floating, never resting.

dos: Keep canvas and ink as the system's two anchor surfaces; every band chooses one or the other.
Push display tracking hard negative and keep the Inter OpenType variants on.
Use blue only for links, focus, selection — and the drop-target ring.
Mark hierarchy with surface lift; selected = one step up, never a tint.
Compose every CTA as a pill and every icon action as a circle.
Keep the gradient scarce — one spotlight card, ever.
donts: Ship a light surface anywhere. The brand is dark.
Make the blue a brand fill — no blue pills, no blue logo tiles.
Square off CTAs or use bordered ghost buttons with transparent fills.
Reduce display negative tracking for accessibility — reduce size, keep the percentage.
Apply gradients to whole sections; gradients are cards.
Color-code file types; the glyph carries the type, folders are ink and files are ink-muted.
